subject: Vulnerability management questionnaire & evidence: Horizon Capital RFI
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@horizoncap.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@horizoncap.com
Date: 2026-08-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vulnerability management questionnaire & SBOM request

Hi Ben and Grace,

Thanks for agreeing to respond to our security onboarding requests as part of Horizon Capital's vendor assessment. Attached is our standard security RFI template (horizon_rfi_template.xlsx). The team is specifically looking for:

- Completed vulnerability management section (SAST, DAST, third-party dependency scanning cadence)
- Patch SLA commitments for customer-impacting vulnerabilities
- Pen test executive summary and remediation status
- SBOM or bill-of-materials for any runtime components we will run in production

Can you please confirm whether you can deliver the VM responses and an SBOM by COB Friday (2026-08-28)? If not, propose a delivery date and any items that require an NDA or redaction.

Regards,
Elena Morales
Head of Vendor Risk | Horizon Capital
elena.morales@horizoncap.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@horizoncap.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vulnerability management questionnaire & SBOM request

Elena — thanks for the template. We can cover the bulk of the VM questionnaire and provide an SBOM export. Quick notes:

- We will provide SAST/DAST cadence details and recent pen test exec summary.
- SBOM: we can provide a component-level CSV for our hosted runtime (redwood_sbom_v1.csv).
- Patch SLAs: we have tiered SLAs depending on severity; I'll have Grace send the definitive SLA table.
- For full pen test reports (vendor PII/notes), we typically require an NDA — happy to make the redacted exec summary public immediately.

Target: submit initial packet by 2026-08-28 EOD. If you need a quicker cutoff for procurement, let us know and we'll prioritize.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@horizoncap.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-26T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood VM responses & evidence (SAST/DAST, patch SLA, SBOM, pentest)

Elena — attaching the artifacts we discussed. See short summary below and attached files: redwood_sbom_v1.csv, pen_test_summary_2026.pdf, patch_sla_table.csv, sast_dast_process.md.

Summary (high level):
- SAST/DAST: We run GitHub-integrated SAST (static analysis) on all public and private repos on every pull request with a daily scheduled full-scan. DAST is run against staging and pre-prod with weekly authenticated scans for critical services. More detail in sast_dast_process.md.
- Dependency scanning & SBOM: We generate an SBOM per release; the attached CSV corresponds to the current production runtime. SBOM contains direct third-party libs and license info.
- Pen tests: Last third-party pen test was May 2026 by SecureAssess; pen_test_summary_2026.pdf includes findings classified and remediation status (all critical findings remediated). The full vendor report can be shared under an NDA — see pentest_fullreport_202605.pdf (requested).
- Patch SLAs: patch_sla_table.csv outlines timelines: Critical (0-72h), High (3-7 days), Medium (30 days), Low (next maintenance window). We also publish CVE disclosures and customer impact notices on our status page.

If you have specific questionnaire rows you'd like us to map to these artifacts, send the row IDs and we'll return a filled workbook.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Product Security | Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@horizoncap.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@horizoncap.com
Date: 2026-08-28T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood VM responses & evidence (SAST/DAST, patch SLA, SBOM, pentest)

Thanks — this is helpful and matches what our review needs. A couple of follow-ups:

1) Procurement will need the redacted full pen test (vendor report) or a signed NDA template we can execute.
2) We require a statement that critical CVEs affecting customer data will be patched within 72 hours and customers notified via email/portal. Your patch_sla_table.csv references 72h for critical, but we need an explicit statement for contract language.

If you can send the NDA and a one-paragraph commitment for the contract team, procurement can move this forward.

Best,
Elena

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@horizoncap.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Jason Lee <j.lee@secureassess.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood VM responses & evidence (SAST/DAST, patch SLA, SBOM, pentest)

Elena — looping in our pen test vendor and attaching the redacted executive pack. Below is the requested contractual statement and vendor confirmation. Attachments: pen_test_summary_2026.pdf, pentest_fullreport_202605.pdf (vendor-provided under NDA).

Contractual statement for procurement: 
"Redwood Inference commits to remediate and ship mitigations for customer-impacting Critical vulnerabilities within seventy-two (72) hours of verification that the vulnerability affects a Redwood-managed production runtime. Redwood will provide affected customers with an initial notification within 24 hours of verification and follow-up status updates until remediation is complete."

Vendor note (forwarded):
On Fri, May 28, 2026 Jason Lee <j.lee@secureassess.com> wrote:
> Executive summary: SecureAssess performed a blackbox + authenticated web assessment of Redwood's hosted runtime. Findings were categorized; no open Critical findings remain following Redwood's remediation work. Full technical report is appended and available under NDA.
>
> Jason Lee
> Principal Consultant | SecureAssess
> j.lee@secureassess.com

Let me know if you need any edits to the statement language for contract redlines. We can provide a signed NDA and the vendor full report through a secure transfer.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com
